query: Периодически выбирай новые записи из PostgreSQL public.orders и сохраняй их в JSON-файл /data/output/orders_export.json.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: orders_export_pipeline
  name: Export Orders to JSON
  description: Periodically export new orders from PostgreSQL to JSON file
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 5 minutes
sources:
- id: source_orders
  name: Read Orders from PostgreSQL
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: public.orders
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DATABASE_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
processing_elements:
- id: filter_new_orders
  name: Filter New Orders
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: created_at > {{LAST_EXPORT_TIMESTAMP}}
    watermark_column: created_at
- id: convert_to_json
  name: Convert to JSON
  operation: Format
  config:
    output_format: json
    array: true
sinks:
- id: sink_json_file
  name: Write JSON File
  type: File
  location: /data/output/orders_export.json
  connection:
    properties:
      file_format: json
      overwrite: true
processed_data:
- id: orders_data
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_orders
  to_id: filter_new_orders
  data_ref: orders_data
- from_id: filter_new_orders
  to_id: convert_to_json
  data_ref: orders_data
- from_id: convert_to_json
  to_id: sink_json_file
  data_ref: orders_data

flowContents.name: Export Orders to JSON
flowContents.comments: Periodically export new orders from PostgreSQL to JSON file
